skill.name: when-using-flow-nexus-platform-use-flow-nexus-platform
skill.description: Guides Flow Nexus setup, deployment, monitoring, and billing through MCP commands, generated configuration, and operational procedures.
skill.summary: Manage Flow Nexus authentication, sandboxes, deployments, monitoring, and billing workflows.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command hits are Markdown code-fence false positives, but real shell-command substitutions and generated executable scripts remain. The skill also forwards API keys and database URLs into Flow Nexus deployment variables and includes billing auto-refill actions, so publication should require strong warnings and author remediation.

remediation.issue: Secrets are forwarded into Flow Nexus deployment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Replace direct ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL examples with a documented secret-management flow and explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Billing auto-refill can be enabled from the procedure and generated script.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit confirmation checkpoint before payment links, refill actions, or auto-refill changes, and default auto-refill to disabled.

remediation.issue: The workflow invokes npx claude-flow@alpha and generated shell scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Pin command versions, document expected commands, and require user approval before executing generated scripts.

remediation.issue: Example credentials are reusable and realistic.
remediation.suggestion: Use non-operational placeholders and add instructions to generate unique credentials outside the prompt.

remediation.issue: A deployment script uploads local file contents to a Flow Nexus sandbox.
remediation.suggestion: Add a file review step and restrict uploads to a generated safe sample directory.

semantic_findings.title: Automated Billing Auto-Refill Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs agents to enable Flow Nexus auto-refill with a threshold and amount, and also generates a billing script that can configure auto-refill. This can create financial changes if executed without explicit account-owner approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly enable auto-refill and create a script path for changing the setting. This is a clear business-logic risk involving paid platform resources.

semantic_findings.title: Reusable Example Credentials in Registration Flow
semantic_findings.description: The registration and login examples use the same visible email and password values. Users could copy these placeholders into a real account, creating predictable credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The hardcoded credentials are visible and repeated in registration and login examples. They appear to be placeholders, so confidence is high enough to flag but not critical.

content.value_statement: Flow Nexus setup can span authentication, sandboxes, deployments, monitoring, and billing. This skill provides a structured operating procedure for those platform tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides Flow Nexus registration, login, session checks, and user profile retrieval.
Shows sandbox creation, storage setup, database schema creation, and real-time subscription steps.
Provides procedures for template deployment and custom application deployment to a sandbox.
Creates example platform configuration, service scripts, and operational documentation.
Covers health checks, sandbox logs, execution files, audit logs, and monitoring checkpoints.
Documents credit balance checks, payment history review, payment links, and auto-refill settings.
limitations: Requires a working Flow Nexus MCP server and valid platform account access.
Uses external Flow Nexus services and may involve paid resources or billing changes.
Command examples must be reviewed before execution in any real workspace.
Example credentials and resource names are placeholders and should be replaced.
